facts.text: The hotel is in Atlanta's Buckhead neighborhood.
facts.excerpt: you’ll experience reimagined luxury in Atlanta’s prestigious Buckhead neighborhood

facts.text: The hotel is one block from MARTA and provides access to Buckhead Village and Lenox Square.
facts.excerpt: One block from MARTA with complimentary house car service within two miles, the hotel provides access to Buckhead Village, Lenox Square.

facts.text: It is an easy half-mile walk along Peachtree Road to Lenox Square and Shops Around Lenox.
facts.excerpt: it’s an easy half-mile walk along Peachtree Road to Lenox Square (David Yurman, Escada) and Shops Around Lenox (Lululemon, Draper James)

facts.text: The rotunda lobby has high-backed chairs around small tables, marble floors and giant planters.
facts.excerpt: Inside the rotunda lobby, high-backed chairs surround small tables and guests sit in hushed conversation. The marble floors, giant planters, and neutral tones (with the occasional pop of orange)

facts.text: Twin murals by Atlanta-based mixed media artist Niki Zarrabi in the Great Hall feature Georgia's state flower, the Cherokee Rose.
facts.excerpt: her twin murals quite fittingly feature Georgia’s state flower, the Cherokee Rose

facts.text: Works by Atlanta-based mixed media artist Niki Zarrabi adorn the walls of the Great Hall.
facts.excerpt: The captivating works of Niki Zarrabi, an Atlanta-based mixed media artist, adorn the walls of the Great Hall.

facts.text: Rooms and suites have designer furniture and monogrammed motifs inspired by Atlanta's architecture.
facts.excerpt: adorned with designer furniture and monogrammed motifs inspired by Atlanta’s architecture

facts.text: Rooms have a luxurious soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: premium TV channels and a luxurious soaking tub make it easy to unwind at the end of the day

facts.text: Rooms have pillow-top beds and a separate shower and tub.
facts.excerpt: Maybe it’s the pillow-top beds, the separate shower and tub, or the tasteful potted plants.

facts.text: The Presidential Suites feature original artwork, plush furnishings and a dual-sided fireplace.
facts.excerpt: Highlights of the Presidential Suites include original artwork, plush furnishings, and a chic dual-sided fireplace.

facts.text: The Club InterContinental lounge is a fully staffed 21st-floor lounge with daily complimentary breakfast, snacks and evening refreshments.
facts.excerpt: our fully staffed 21st-floor lounge featuring daily complimentary breakfast, snacks, and evening refreshments

facts.text: The Club Lounge has skyline views of Buckhead.
facts.excerpt: an exclusive sky-high retreat featuring stunning skyline views of Buckhead

facts.text: The spa is paired with an adjacent fitness center and a heated outdoor saltwater pool.
facts.excerpt: Our expansive spa offers InterContinental guests an elevated Buckhead Atlanta wellness experience, seamlessly paired with an adjacent state-of-the-art fitness center and heated outdoor saltwater pool.

facts.text: Spa treatments range from antioxidant facials to lavender mud wraps.
facts.excerpt: The small spa offers a full menu of treatments, from antioxidant facials to lavender mud wraps

facts.text: The heated saltwater Peachtree Pool and Sun Terrace are open year-round.
facts.excerpt: Our heated saltwater Peachtree Pool and Sun Terrace are open year-round for swimming, socializing and summertime drinks and snacks served poolside.

facts.text: The fitness center and pool are on the 2nd floor.
facts.excerpt: Fitness Center and Pool: 2nd Floor

facts.text: The pool includes a whirlpool.
facts.excerpt: Pool includes: Whirlpool

facts.text: Cabanas can be booked at Peachtree Pool, with a cheese and charcuterie board paired with Chandon Garden Spritz or Whispering Angel Rosé.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your summer with a cabana stay at Peachtree Pool. Enjoy a premium cheese and charcuterie board paired perfectly with your choice of Chandon Garden Spritz or Whispering Angel Rosé.

facts.text: The fitness center has Peloton bikes.
facts.excerpt: Our cutting-edge Buckhead, Atlanta hotel fitness center features Peloton bikes

facts.text: The Americano is helmed by chef Scott Conant and features fine steaks, freshly made pasta, Mediterranean seafood and an extensive wine list.
facts.excerpt: Helmed by celebrity chef and two-time James Beard Award-winner Chef Scott Conant, The Americano features fine steaks, freshly made pasta, Mediterranean seafood, and an extensive wine list.

facts.text: Aperitivo Hour runs daily at the bar or patio of The Americano, with spritzes, Campari cocktails and a charcuterie board.
facts.excerpt: Gather daily at the bar or patio at The Americano for Aperitivo Hour — featuring vibrant spritzes and cocktails with Campari, alongside our charcuterie board, perfect for sharing.

facts.text: The Sorrento Room is an indoor/outdoor breakfast spot with fresh-baked pastries, breakfast sandwiches and classic hot dishes.
facts.excerpt: is open for breakfast and offers a selection of fresh-baked pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and classic hot dishes

facts.text: Live music plays in The Great Hall on Friday and Saturday evenings.
facts.excerpt: Start at The Americano Bar, cocktail in hand, then head to The Great Hall for live music.
